description: This is a PHP source file defining the GDPR model class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It contains methods to interact with the GDPR-related database records, such as editing status, deleting records, retrieving GDPR data with filters, and fetching expiration records.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: A model class for managing GDPR-related database operations within the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a GDPR record identified by gdpr_id.

methods.name: deleteGdpr
methods.description: Deletes a GDPR record from the database based on gdpr_id.

methods.name: deleteGdprsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes GDPR records associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getGdprs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of GDPR records filtered by various criteria.

methods.name: getGdpr
methods.description: Retrieves a specific GDPR record by gdpr_id.

methods.name: getTotalGdprs
methods.description: Counts the total number of GDPR records matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Fetches GDPR records that are expired or due to expire based on status and date.
